metadata.title: Clicked like I owed them a sandwich and somehow got that 1 clueless kill? Valorant logic WTF
metadata.description:
Clicked like my brain was on vacation.
Enemy probably uninstalling from pure confusion.
Pretending I meant that for a hot 0.12 seconds.
Click if your aim’s a total mystery but kills still roll in!

Tap if your aim’s chaos but kills still happen!

#valorant #gamingfails #funnygaming #luckshot #shorts
